ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels across approx. 98% of the surface area with localized high-intensity (white) pixel clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous dark pigmentation across both lobes. Absence of large-scale geometric blobs or mottling; presence of localized high-contrast circular point-features.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an internal angle of approximately 65 degrees and a deep vertical bounding-box penetration.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the full trailing edge with pixel-amplitude variations of approximately 5-15 pixels from the mean edge line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature originating from the peduncle, tapering to sharp points at the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast circular white ring-clusters distributed primarily on the lateral margins of the left lobe and the central-to-lateral region of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One distinct vertical linear white disruption on the inner lower quadrant of the right lobe; several smaller, faint horizontal abrasions on the left lobe mid-section.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle scarification (white rosettes) and linear rake marks; small calcified protrusions visible on the outer tip of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible barnacle colonization along the extreme peripheral edges of the fluke tips.
